run_vllm_runner_generate: run vllm_runner to generate text from prompts using greedy decoding with max tokens
run_hf_runner_generate: run hf_runner to generate text from prompts using transformers model with greedy decoding
run_vllm_runner_beam_search: run vllm_runner to perform beam search generation with specified beam width and max tokens
run_hf_runner_classify: run hf_runner to classify text prompts using a sentence transformer or cross encoder model
run_local_asset_server: run local_asset_server to start a threaded HTTP server that serves test image assets
